blocking.claim: "January the roughest month (0.71 m average, up to 1.46 m on the biggest days recorded)"
blocking.problem: Misreads the trusted dataset. site/data/beaches/cherry-beach-1.json waves.height_big_m is indexed Jan–Dec; January's own big-day figure (index 0) is 1.34 m. The 1.46 m value is April's big-day figure (index 3) and equals waves.summary.peak_big_day_m, an annual peak — not January's. The sentence misattributes the annual peak to January.
blocking.evidence: site/data/beaches/cherry-beach-1.json: height_big_m=[1.34,1.28,1.14,1.46,0.58,0.72,0.44,0.56,0.72,0.92,1.18,1.06] (index0=Jan=1.34, index3=Apr=1.46); summary.peak_big_day_m=1.46 with no month attached in the summary object itself.
blocking.fix: Replace "up to 1.46 m on the biggest days recorded" with "up to 1.34 m on its biggest days" (January's own figure), or, if the annual peak is worth keeping, add the correct month: "...with the year's single highest reading, 1.46 m, recorded in April."
